notes: Registration input, not a run input: Deribit's ETH DVOL implied-volatility index at 1-minute resolution, from the public JSON-RPC endpoint public/get_volatility_index_data (no credential), through the restwindow pack (ADR-0237, named by import path). DVOL is Deribit's 30-day implied volatility index in annualised percentage points (the BTC index read about 35 on 2026-10-01, probed), a second implied-vol input beside Binance's BVOL (which is research-only; confirm Deribit's terms before any live use). Rows sit at result.data as [timestamp_ms, open, high, low, close]; the timestamp is the START of the minute (a bar is complete at ts + 60 s: use its close only after that), and `epoch` writes the ISO effective instant into ts_iso. Windows: the vendor returns at most 1000 rows and, when it cuts a range short, keeps the NEWEST rows and sets result.continuation, a silent truncation, so truncated_path makes the connector refuse that window instead of storing it partial; step 43200 s is 720 rows, under the cap. lag 60 skips the minute still forming. RETENTION (probed 2026-10-07): the vendor serves 1-minute DVOL for only about 185 days, the first row being 2026-04-04T19:21Z; windows of 2024-01-01, 2026-01-01 and 2026-04-01 return an empty result.data and no continuation, so a pull from there would gate pass with most of its windows empty, while resolution 3600 serves every probed day of 2024 to 2026. start 2026-04-08 is inside the retention; the retention slides a day a day, so a later pull's first ts is later than start (runbook section 8 prints it). For a longer history declare a second source with resolution 3600 (hourly rows) instead of moving this start earlier. From start to 2026-10-07 is about 365 windows (a few minutes at pace_s 0.2) and max_windows 3000 refuses a span that has outgrown it. Register: python -m dskit.onboarding register-source deribit-eth-dvol --catalog-source deribit-eth-dvol --connector dskit.onboarding.libs.restwindow:RestWindowConnector --config @configs/source-deribit-eth-dvol.json --activate --root <store root>; then acquire --source deribit-eth-dvol --stream dvol --mode backfill; validate with configs/suite-deribit-dvol.json.

dvol.notes: row_fields names the five positions; epoch reads `ts` as epoch milliseconds and writes the ISO effective instant into ts_iso.

pagination.notes: A 43200 s window is 720 one-minute rows. time_format epoch_ms renders the bounds the way the vendor reads them; truncated_path names the marker of a silent cut.
